product_overview: A role-based learning platform where students can register, log in, browse classes and modules, complete exercises, and review submission feedback. The current built experience focuses on the full student learning workflow, while teacher and admin experiences are not included in the testable product.
core_goals: Create an account and access the platform with email/password authentication
Browse enrolled classes and inspect class details such as assignments, lesson plans, and roster
Discover learning modules, filter and search them, and open module details
Complete writing or speaking exercises and submit responses
Review submitted work, grades, and teacher feedback
Edit profile details such as name and avatar URL

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Users can create an account, log in, and access the app based on their role.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Enter full name -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Choose a user role -> Submit the registration form -> Land on the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit the login form -> Land on the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit the login form -> See an access-denied redirect to the login page when credentials are invalid

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Students can view current learning activity, including upcoming assignments, in-progress modules, and recent submissions.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View due assignments -> View module progress -> View recent submissions -> Open a linked class, module, or submission

features.name: Classes
features.description: Students can view their enrolled classes and inspect each class for assignments, lesson plans, and roster details.
user_flows: Navigate to /classes -> View enrolled classes list -> Open a class -> View assignments, lesson plans, and roster
Navigate to /classes -> View empty class list -> Follow the link to the module catalog

features.name: Modules
features.description: Students can browse available modules, search and filter them, and open a module to see its details and exercises.
user_flows: Navigate to /modules -> Search for a module by title -> Filter modules by difficulty -> View matching modules with progress indicators -> Open a module
Navigate to /modules -> View module list -> Open a module -> View module overview and exercise list

features.name: Exercises
features.description: Students can complete writing or speaking exercises and submit their work for review.
user_flows: Open an exercise from a module -> Read the instruction text -> Type a written response or provide a speaking response URL -> Observe the live word count for writing -> Save a draft locally -> Submit the exercise -> Return to the app after submission
Open an exercise from a module -> Read the instruction text -> Enter an incomplete written response -> Submit the exercise -> See validation feedback for the required input

features.name: Submissions
features.description: Students can review their submission history, filter by status, and open a submission to see grading feedback.
user_flows: Navigate to /submissions -> View all submissions -> Filter by awaiting review or graded -> Open a submission -> View the original prompt, submitted answer, score, and feedback
Navigate to /submissions -> View the newest exercise submission marked as awaiting review -> Open it later after grading -> See the score and feedback update

features.name: Profile
features.description: Users can edit their profile information and sign out of the platform.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile -> Edit full name -> Edit avatar URL -> Save changes -> See the updated profile reflected in the app shell
Navigate to /profile -> Log out -> Return to /login
